messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 2790123456 - High error rate observed for Dedicated inference pools in eu-west-1. Route failures and 5xxs spiking for dedicated customers; automated fallback to compatible model variants attempted. Pager: maria (oncall) · Severity: P1 · Initial detection: 13:12 UTC

maria (oncall): I'm on it. Observed increased 502/504 from routing layer to runtime v2. Rolling back the last routing change in prod-eu for canary nodes. tagging @jordan for runtime traces.

jordan (eng-sre): grabbing traces now. KV cache evictions and rejected requests spike at ~13:10. Looks like a routing policy started directing long-seq requests to small-queue nodes. Possible scheduling regression. Capturing heap/metrics.

deploy-bot: Deploy 2789999999 (routing-config) rollback started by maria. Canary rollback in progress: eu-west-1-canary-2 -> reverted.

maria (oncall): rollback complete on canary. Error rate reduced on canary but still elevated cluster-wide. Need cross-check on autoscale and burst pools. @ops-shadow please confirm if dedicated autoscaler flapping is happening.

ops-shadow: Affirming flaps on dedicated-pool-eu-1 from 13:09-13:18, several scale-downs immediately followed by spikes. Suspect aggressive scale-down policy + short TTL on caches.

jordan (eng-sre): I see two contributing factors: routing policy index mismatch (recent config change) and a quantization cache thrash on specific model variants. Working a fix: temporarily pin routing-policy to stable-2026-02 and increase autoscale cool-down to 120s for dedicated pools.

anita (cs-lead): Alerting affected Enterprise accounts now. Prioritizing high-touch customers with dedicated instances. List of impacted enterprise accounts we should notify immediately:
- Orchid Health (dedicated-eu: orchid-prod-1, orchid-prod-2) - high impact
- Peregrine Labs (dedicated-eu: peregrine-prod) - moderate impact
- Meridian Analytics (shared but heavy; possible performance degradation) - advisory

sam (product): Drafting tailored customer statements. Use the template below for Orchid Health (suggested):

```
Orchid Health — Impact Notification (for CS/Account teams)
We detected elevated errors and degraded response times for your dedicated inference pools in eu-west-1 between 13:08–13:30 UTC, which may have caused failed requests or slow responses for some of your calls. Our engineering team has rolled back a recent routing change and applied temporary autoscale adjustments to stabilize the service.
Current status: Partial mitigation in place; traffic is routing to stable nodes and error rates are decreasing. We are continuing to monitor and will provide another update within 30 minutes.
If you are seeing persistent failures, please reply to this thread or contact your account team. We apologize for the disruption.
```

kyle (support): For CS channels: please include the following in customer comms to reduce churn risk:
- Direct contact: anita@redwood.ai + phone +44 20 7123 4567 (primary CSM)
- Short mitigation instructions: retry with exponential backoff, avoid long-sequence batched requests for 20 minutes
- Status page link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2790123456

anita (cs-lead): Sending first-out notification to Orchid now using the template. Will paste outbound email into thread when sent.

anita (cs-lead): outbound-email-draft ->
Subject: Immediate: Impact to Orchid dedicated inference in eu-west-1
Hi Team Orchid —
We’re seeing degraded performance for your dedicated instances (orchid-prod-1/2) in eu-west-1 affecting some requests between 13:08–13:30 UTC. Engineering has applied a rollback and autoscaling changes; we expect continued improvement over the next 30 minutes. If you experience ongoing errors, reply here or use your CSM line below.
Regards,
Anita, Redwood Customer Success

maria (oncall): Technical update for internal ops: pinned routing-policy -> stable-2026-02; autoscale cooldown increased 60s -> 120s; temporarily increased worker queue depth for dedicated pools to reduce rejections. Observability: enabling higher-fidelity traces for any 5xx for next 45 minutes.

jordan (eng-sre): Patching quantization cache hot-path to avoid eviction storms; push ID 2790123465 applied to eu-west runtime nodes. Monitoring shows 60% reduction in KV cache evictions on patched nodes.

incident-bot: [STATUS PAGE DRAFT] 2790123456 - Degraded dedicated inference in eu-west-1. Current state: Partial mitigation applied; rollback and autoscale adjustments reduced failures. Next update at ~13:45 UTC. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2790123456

sam (product): Customer-facing status blurb (short):
"We experienced elevated error rates for dedicated inference in eu-west-1 starting at ~13:08 UTC. We rolled back a routing config and made autoscale adjustments; services are stabilizing and we continue to monitor."

anita (cs-lead): Sent to Orchid with Cc to Peregrine. Peregrine CS will send a lighter advisory note (they run multi-tenant but saw slow responses).

kyle (support): Support playbook updates:
- Tag all incoming tickets from Orchid/Peregrine with `incident:2790123456`
- Escalate any reports of >10% failure rate or sustained >30s latencies to oncall immediately
- Provide workaround: short-term retry + reduce request payload sizes

ops-shadow: Continuing to observe decreased error-rate trend. Recommending we keep autoscale cooldown at 120s and revert queue depth after 60 minutes of stable metrics.

maria (oncall): Preparing handoff to second oncall in 30 minutes. Current action items:
- jordan: keep monitoring KV cache / traces
- anita/kyle: confirm outbound emails and support tags applied
- sam: finalize status page blurb
- ops-shadow: keep autoscale settings and advise on revert cadence

jordan (eng-sre): Logging final note before handoff: root cause (likely) = routing policy mismatch + aggressive scale-down + cache eviction cascade. Long-term follow-ups: stricter config validation for routing policies, autoscale policy review, and cache TTL heuristics. Creating tickets now.

maria (oncall): Handoff to oncall (eve-shift) in 30m. If anything regresses ping +44 78 9999 0000 or DM me. :wave:
